page.overview:
Who is Akerspaark's children?

King Akerspaark of Maecht had many legitimate children (as well as an untold number of illegitimate ones). The following are known:

Gonzalez was one of Akerspaark's legitimate sons.

Gorm was one of Akerspaark's legitimate sons.

Orm was the eldest legitimate son of Akerspaark.
